title: FishPve
description: FishPve is a Minecraft plugin for PvE servers with a custom fishing system, rewards and loot balance.
body:
FishPve is a Minecraft server plugin that transforms fishing into a full progression and earning system. Players can catch custom fish of different rarities with unique weight and value, sell their catch for coins, and compete on the top fishermen leaderboard.

The plugin is actively developed and maintained by Pershkin. If you want to follow the updates, report bugs, or suggest new features for future versions, feel free to join the community!

⚙ Features

    Custom fish with rarity, weight, and dynamic prices

    Fish selling system with full Vault integration

    Top fishermen leaderboard and detailed player statistics

    Custom fishing rods (Basic, Master, Ocean) with unique bonuses

    Fully configurable levels, chances, prices, and messages

    Item protection against duplication

    SQLite database for secure data storage

    Optional anti–auto-fishing captcha system to prevent cheating

📜 Commands

    /fish sell — sell your fish

    /fish top — view leaderboard

    /fish give <player> <rod_id> — give a custom fishing rod

    /fish stats <player> — view player statistics

    /fish captcha <code> — complete captcha

    /fish reload — reload configuration

🔑 Permissions

    fishing.use

    fishing.sell

    fishing.admin

🎥 Video Showcase: https://youtu.be/GjOfKAU5o2g (by Pershkin)
